subject: Medford High School Building Site Selection
overview: The High School Building Committee reviewed the architect selection schedule, received an update on the project's educational plan, and voted to narrow the list of potential building sites for the feasibility study.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the June 11 meeting.

items.title: Project Invoices
items.summary: Approved two invoices totaling $50,000 for Left Field services, pending a date correction on the second invoice to reflect July services.

items.title: Designer Selection Process
items.summary: Matt Gulino provided a timeline for the designer selection process, noting that over 20 architectural firms have requested the RFS and proposals are due August 27.

items.title: Designer Evaluation Materials
items.summary: The committee reviewed the qualifications-based evaluation matrices and reference check procedures to be used for shortlisting architectural firms.

items.title: Educational Plan Update
items.summary: Dr. Suzanne Galusi detailed the development of the educational plan, including administrative retreats and teacher tours of high schools in Dover, Waltham, and Attleboro.

items.title: Feasibility Study Site Options
items.summary: Voted to remove Medford Square and Columbus Park from the feasibility study site list due to size constraints and conflicting development projects.
